name: expense-webapp
description: The single-page app both Employees and Managers sign into. Employees photograph and submit expense claims, review agent-prefilled details, and track claim status; Managers review their team's claims, approve or reject them, and set the team's weekly limit in plain language. Holds no business data itself — everything is read from and written to expense-api and expense-assistant.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Creates and reviews expense claims and reads the team's weekly limit.

dependencies.name: expense-assistant
dependencies.description: Sends the uploaded receipt photo to pre-fill a claim, and the manager's plain-language weekly limit statement to be interpreted.
